source_citation: Diggs, Lipscomb & O'Kennon (1999), Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas

morphology_source_reported.growth_habit: Deciduous tree, 20–30 m tall, colonial by root sprouts
morphology_source_reported.leaves: Odd-pinnately compound with 7–19 leaflets [genus]; nighttime drooping leaflets reported
morphology_source_reported.young_tissue: Young stems and leaves glabrous [species key]
morphology_source_reported.flowers: Fragrant white flowers 1.5–2.5 cm long, ca. 10–35 in pendent axillary racemes
morphology_source_reported.fruits: Compressed linear-oblong pods 5–10 cm long [genus + species]
